turns.text: Kickoff for Project Monsoon and the separate Moonstone stream: keep the two names cleanly separated in memory. Monsoon is the logistics routing pilot; Moonstone is the field-reporting workflow program, and cross-project summaries must not mix customer, budget, vendor, or incident details.

For Moonstone, keep the customer reference as Apex Field Services. The names Monsoon and Moonstone are intentionally similar, so retrieval and summaries need extra care.
